Create a single regimen

create_regimen.Rd

The resulting data.frame can be passed to create_sim_dataset() as the regimen argument.

Usage

create_regimen(
  dose,
  interval = 24,
  n,
  t_inf = NULL,
  route = c("oral", "iv", "sc", "im"),
  per = NULL
)

Arguments

dose

TODO

interval

TODO

n

TODO

t_inf

TODO

route

TODO

per

character or NULL. Name of a column in the simulation dataset whose value is used to scale each subject's dose (e.g. per = "WT" for mg/kg dosing, per = "BSA" for mg/m² dosing). The final AMT for each subject is dose * covariate_value. When NULL (the default), the dose is applied as an absolute amount.

Value

TODO

Examples


if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
reg1 <- create_regimen(
  dose = 500,
  interval = 12,
  n = 10,
  route = "oral"
)
create_sim_dataset(..., regimen = reg1)

# Weight-based dosing (5 mg/kg):
reg2 <- create_regimen(dose = 5, per = "WT", interval = 24, n = 5, route = "sc")
create_sim_dataset(..., regimen = reg2)
} # }
